description: A placeholder passed to a function called on NULL input (not STRICT) may be NULL: the function handles it, as a report's optional filter does
name: called_on_null_input_argument
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, hidden BOOLEAN NOT NULL);

CREATE FUNCTION accounts_report(only_hidden boolean) RETURNS TABLE (id integer) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT a.id FROM accounts a WHERE only_hidden IS NULL OR a.hidden = only_hidden; END $$;
